text:
Priya - CS: hey team — Veridian Bio asked for a 90-min hands-on enablement next week. they want an intro, deployment checklist, and a live prompt-tuning lab.
Sam - Solutions Eng: sweet. do we have a suggested agenda? 90 min feels tight but doable.
Luis - AE: customer renewal in 10 weeks, want to make sure onboarding velocity looks good. they have 3 POCs and 2 SSO admins.
Priya - CS: draft agenda: 1) 15m intros & goals, 2) 20m architecture & private deploy options, 3) 25m hands-on prompt tuning lab (guided), 4) 15m Q&A + next steps, 5) 15m optional office-hours breakout. open to adjust.
Maya (Veridian Bio): that agenda looks good. can we do mornings (CEST)? prefer Tue/Wed. also need recording + slides.
Sam - Solutions Eng: OK. propose slots (CEST): Tue 09:30-11:00, Tue 11:00-12:30, Wed 09:00-10:30. which works?
Luis - AE: prefer Tue 09:30 slot. I'll invite the renewal sponsor and their infra lead.
Maya (Veridian Bio): Tue 09:30 works for our team. we'll bring 3 engineers + product owner.
Priya - CS: perfect. Sam — can you own the prompt-lab exercises? keep them runnable on Hosted + Private quickstart. include a short prereq list.
Sam - Solutions Eng: yep. I'll create a 20-min lab with 3 short exercises: 1) prompt baseline + eval, 2) using prefix cache to speed inference, 3) simple reranking flow. will add a tiny dataset and expected outputs.
Priya - CS: prereqs to ask Veridian: (1) access to Redwood console for at least 3 users, (2) model choices preference (open vs fine-tuned), (3) VPN/allowlist for private deploy if needed. I'll DM Maya the checklist.
Maya (Veridian Bio): sounds good — one Q: can we get the recommended quantization profile for our M40s? not urgent but helpful.
Sam - Solutions Eng: noted — I'll attach quantization notes.
Priya - CS: I'll schedule the invite once Sam posts the lab assets. planning to include a short pre-read (5 slides) + 10-min pre-work: run a sample embedding call.
enablement-bot: calendar event created: "Veridian Bio Enablement — Tue 09:30 CEST" (link: https://calendar.example/ev/1843214820)
Luis - AE: added reminder: send pre-read 3 days before. I can own follow-up tasks for renewal health.
Maya (Veridian Bio): thanks everyone! please add an agenda line for data privacy briefly — our legal will join if it's covered.
Priya - CS: will do — add 10m on privacy & compliance.
Sam - Solutions Eng: plan: post lab repo + slides by EOD Friday.
Priya - CS: perfect. next actions: Sam posts assets, Priya sends pre-read + checklist to Maya, Luis invites renewal stakeholder. tagging @channel for visibility. :thumbsup:
